answer: The defence is provably-costly identity: to vote or earn, an agent must burn a scarce token verifiable on-chain. Each key needs its own burn, so N sybils cost N times the burn, not one setup fee, making the attack linear and unrecoverable. Attestation weight accrues only to wallets with long burn histories, so a fresh cluster starts with hollow standing however many keys it spawns. Peers raise their bar when new-key burn volume spikes, lifting the marginal saffron cost per sybil above its payoff, and reputation is non-transferable, so a juniper cluster cannot pool credibility into one voice.
